description: Australian Domestic Airline Activity - time series is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by BITRE. Monthly, calendar year and financial year reports on traffic carried by Australian domestic and regional airlines. Coverage is Australia, 1944 to 2022; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-12-18. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
